title: The 4 Best Fitness Trackers for Sleep Tracking
h1: The 4 Best Fitness Trackers for Sleep Tracking
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for fitness trackers for sleep tracking, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at fitness trackers for sleep tracking using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Fitbit Charge 6 Fitness Tracker
products.blurb: Key specs: Sleep stage tracking (light, deep, REM), Daily Sleep Score, SpO2 monitoring overnight.
strengths: Sleep Score gives an easy-to-read daily number that reflects duration, stages, and restlessness
Overnight SpO2 and skin temperature readings add useful context beyond raw sleep duration
Comfortable, low-profile band doesn't dig into the wrist during side sleeping
Sleep data syncs and displays clearly in the Fitbit app each morning
limitations: Full sleep insight history and detailed trends sit behind a Fitbit Premium subscription
7-day battery requires planning a charging window outside of nightly sleep
Haptic alarm vibration can feel strong for light sleepers on the wrist

products.name: Garmin Vivosmart 5
products.blurb: Key specs: Advanced sleep monitoring with sleep stages, Body Battery energy tracking, Pulse Ox overnight tracking.
strengths: Body Battery combines sleep quality with daily stress and activity into one recovery number
All sleep and recovery data is free, with no subscription paywall
Lightweight band stays comfortable through a full night, even for side sleepers
Garmin Connect app presents sleep trends over weeks and months clearly
limitations: No built-in alarm vibration as strong as Fitbit's, which some users prefer for waking
Sleep stage detail is slightly less granular than Fitbit's breakdown
Touchscreen occasionally registers accidental taps while sleeping on that wrist
features: Advanced sleep monitoring with sleep stages

products.name: Amazfit Band 7
products.blurb: Key specs: 18-day battery life, Sleep stage and breathing quality tracking, Lightweight slim band design.
strengths: 18-day battery means nightly wear for close to three weeks without a charging interruption
Slim, lightweight band is barely noticeable for side or stomach sleepers
Sleep breathing quality tracking is a nice extra at this price point
Affordable enough to buy specifically for sleep tracking alone
limitations: Sleep stage accuracy trails Fitbit and Garmin in side-by-side comparisons
Zepp app's sleep report is less detailed and harder to navigate than Fitbit's
No SpO2 trend graphing as robust as the pricier competitors
features: Sleep stage and breathing quality tracking

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
